svg.title: Federal Funds Matchmaker for North Carolina Agencies: Solution Architecture (C4 Container)
svg.desc: C4 container diagram. The sponsor is NC OSBM. A daily Container Apps Job (11:00 UTC) pulls Grants.gov opportunities once and normalizes them once. Then, for each agency profile (NC DHHS from the NCDHHS Strategic Plan 2026-2030, NC DEQ from the NCDEQ Strategic Plan 2025-2029), it scores them with a hybrid plan-alignment signal (an Azure OpenAI embedding margin against off-topic fields, averaged with TF-IDF word similarity) and funder history from USAspending.gov, runs a checked AI review with Azure OpenAI chat on the top 45, and publishes that agency's JSON files to Azure Blob Storage. A Flask web app on Azure Container Apps has an agency switcher, lets each agency's grants coordinator record Pursue, Maybe or Pass decisions, and has a Statewide page for the OSBM central team. One image, ffm:v6, is built in Azure Container Registry; logs go to Log Analytics. Planned items (Entra ID sign-in, Key Vault and managed identity, Application Insights, private endpoints, AI Search or Cosmos DB, SAM.gov, email or Teams alerts) are dashed.
svg.text: Federal Funds Matchmaker for North Carolina Agencies: Solution Architecture
Team 14, UNC Solve-a-thon 2026 • Sponsor: NC OSBM • Agencies: NC DHHS, NC DEQ • C4 Level 2 (Container) with context • As-built (solid) + planned (dashed) • 2026-11-07 • v1.2

g.text: Decisions store a typed name or initials.
Any visitor can switch to any agency.
Entra ID sign-in is planned (dashed box).

svg.text: Azure subscription unc-sdis-solveathon-team14 · resource group rg-ffm-team14 · region eastus2

g.text: [Container: Azure Container App · Python Flask + gunicorn · MODE=app]
Agency switcher (remembered in the session) for each agency's shortlist,
detail (reason, checked quotes, score breakdown, award history, official link),
Pursue / Maybe / Pass + note, CSV export, funding-by-goal, evaluation, run status,
agency profile; Statewide page (/statewide) for the OSBM central team
1 vCPU / 2 GiB · 1 replica · external HTTPS ingress → port 8000
Reads and writes Blob only; never calls an AI model
cron 0 11 * * * = 11:00 UTC (6 AM EST, 7 AM EDT)
One Grants.gov pull, normalized once; then for each
agency profile: score → AI review (top 45) → publish
eligibility, 10% time to apply, 5% funder history
High ≥55, Medium ≥45 · plan alignment: see note
Retry 1 · timeout 3600 s · non-zero exit on failure
One template; app + job read all
AI review: top 40 agency + top 5 research,
per agency · no tools; never sets the score
App + job console logs, access log
[Platform: secrets on the app and the job]
[Platform: ACR, Basic SKU · admin user enabled for pulls]
Image ffm:v6 deployed to app + job (one image, MODE=app|job)
Queued az acr build --no-logs; the deploy script polls the run
Awards and NC recipients by listing, FY2022-2025
Notation: C4 model, Level 2 (Container), with people and
external systems for context. Arrows point in the direction
of the request; responses flow back.
{id} = agency id (ncdhhs, ncdeq): one file or folder per agency.
Secret values are never shown; they are masked as ****.
TF-IDF = word-based text similarity (see the note in the key).

svg.text: Flow key (set-up, then the daily job, then staff use)

text.tspan: Plan PDFs (OSBM website) → Team: hand-built agency/profiles/ncdhhs.json (2026-2030 plan) and ncdeq.json (2025-2029 plan), one template, second review
Team → ACR + Container Apps: queued az acr build --no-logs (image ffm:v6, includes the profiles), az containerapp create/update · HTTPS, Azure CLI sign-in
ACR → Web App + Job: pull image ffm:v6 at start · HTTPS, ACR admin username/password (planned: managed identity)
Job → Grants.gov: one search2 pull for all agencies (posted + forecasted; 80 keyword searches for the baseline only), fetchOpportunity · HTTPS/JSON, no key
Job → USAspending.gov: awards and NC recipients per listing, FY2022-2025, cached; each agency matched by its recipient-name pattern · HTTPS/JSON, no key
Job → Azure OpenAI embed: listing text, each agency's objectives, 10 off-topic field descriptions → 512-dim vectors, cached by text hash · HTTPS, API key
Job → Azure OpenAI chat, top 45 per agency: listing + matched objective → JSON review with quotes checked in Python · HTTPS, API key
Job ↔ Blob: read caches, earlier results; write raw, details, opportunities, runs (shared); profiles, scored, alerts (per agency) · HTTPS, connection string
Coordinators → Web App: choose agency, shortlist, Pursue/Maybe/Pass + note, CSV for the weekly leadership email · HTTPS, no sign-in, CSRF token
Leads + leadership → Web App: detail and funding-by-goal pages (routed items arrive via the coordinator) · HTTPS, no sign-in
OSBM → Web App /statewide: per agency High/Medium, closing ≤ 10 days, forecasts, decisions; strong matches for 2+ agencies · HTTPS, no sign-in, read only
Labelers → Web App: blind relevance labels on the Evaluation page, per agency · HTTPS, no sign-in, typed labeler name
Web App ↔ Blob: read scored, alerts, profiles, runs, baseline; write decisions/{id}.json, eval/{id}/ labels (ETag check) and sample · HTTPS, connection string
Web App + Job → Log Analytics: console output and gunicorn access log · Container Apps platform
Job → SAM.gov (planned): second opportunity source · would need an API key (store it in Key Vault)
Job → Email / Teams (planned): deadline alerts for new and closing-soon items
Plan alignment = 0.5 × embedding margin + 0.5 × TF-IDF similarity. Margin = similarity to a plan objective minus the best similarity to

g.text: 10 short off-topic field descriptions (NC DHHS: e.g. defense, arts, physics; NC DEQ has its own, e.g. health care). TF-IDF alone without Azure OpenAI.
